task_description: Implement per-station push notification subscriptions using OneSignal Data Tags with TDD approach. Replace broadcast-based notifications with tag-based targeting. Each station gets a bell icon for subscribe/unsubscribe. Backend uses OneSignal filters API instead of included_segments.

verification.summary: All 51 tests pass across 6 test files. Build (tsc && vite build) succeeds. Tests exercise real code paths: notification service tests verify OneSignal SDK interactions and localStorage persistence, hook tests verify state management, component tests verify UI rendering and interaction, backend tests verify payload structure with tag-based filters.
